enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, resting for the early cafe opening shift
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed in Bedroom 2 on her side. Pulls the blanket up to her shoulders. Closes her eyes. Remains still with slow steady breathing. Turns onto her back. Turns onto her other side. Keeps the light off. Does not get out of bed. Remains under the blanket until the alarm at 05:15.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and changing into barista work clothes (bathroom free, as Member 1 is still out on the night shift and Members 3 and 6 are asleep)
enriched_activities.desc: Reaches out and presses the phone alarm to stop it. Sits up on the bed. Swings her legs off the bed. Stands up. Walks out of Bedroom 2 to the bathroom. Pushes the bathroom door open. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Bends over the sink. Cups water and washes her face. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel and wipes her face. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes her teeth. Rinses her mouth with water. Spits into the sink. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns off the tap. Picks up her barista work clothes. Pulls off her sleepwear. Pulls on the work shirt and trousers. Ties the apron around her waist. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick breakfast with tea, and packing a clearly labelled lunch box for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a mug and a box of tea. Puts a tea bag into the mug. Fills the kettle with water at the sink. Puts the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch to boil. Opens the fridge. Takes out the milk. Pours milk into the mug. Pours the boiled water into the mug. Stirs the tea with a spoon. Opens the cupboard and takes out a bowl and cereal. Pours cereal into the bowl. Eats the cereal with a spoon while standing at the bench. Drinks the tea. Opens the fridge again. Takes out a lunch box and containers of food. Spoons rice and cooked food into the lunch box. Closes the lunch box lid. Picks up a marker pen. Writes her name on the lunch box label. Presses the label onto the lunch box lid. Puts the lunch box into her backpack. Closes the fridge door. Washes the mug and bowl at the sink. Puts them on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: drive the EV to the cafe for the opening shift (no other member is using the electric vehicle at this time)
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up her keys and phone from the kitchen bench. Puts the phone in her pocket. Picks up the backpack. Walks to the front door. Opens the front door. Steps out. Closes the front door behind her. Locks the front door with the key. Walks to the electric vehicle. Presses the key fob to unlock the EV. Opens the driver door. Sits in the driver seat. Puts the backpack on the passenger seat. Fastens the seat belt. Presses the start button. Grips the steering wheel. Shifts the gear to reverse. Backs out of the driveway. Shifts to drive. Drives along the street. Stops at the intersection. Signals and turns onto the main road. Drives to the cafe. Pulls into the parking spot. Presses the park button. Switches off the EV. Unfastens the seat belt. Picks up the backpack. Opens the door. Steps out. Locks the EV with the key fob. Walks to the cafe door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the barista opening shift: setting up, pulling espresso shots, serving the morning rush and cleaning down the machine
enriched_activities.desc: Unlocks the cafe front door and pushes it open. Turns on the shop lights. Walks behind the counter. Switches on the espresso machine. Waits for it to heat. Opens the bean hopper lid. Pours coffee beans into the hopper. Closes the lid. Grinds beans into the portafilter. Tamps the grounds with the tamper. Locks the portafilter into the group head. Presses the brew button. Pulls espresso shots into cups. Pours milk into a pitcher. Steams the milk with the steam wand. Pours the milk into the cups. Puts lids on the takeaway cups. Calls out order names. Hands cups to customers. Presses the register keys to take payment. Gives change to customers. Wipes the counter with a cloth. Restocks cups and lids from the shelf. Opens the fridge and takes out milk cartons. Refills the milk jugs. Serves the morning rush queue. Clears used cups and plates into the tub. Wipes tables with a cloth. Empties the coffee grounds knock box. Flushes the group head. Brushes the machine with the cleaning brush. Backflushes the espresso machine. Wipes the steam wand. Turns off the machine. Wipes down the counter and bench at the end of the shift.

enriched_activities.activity: drive the EV back home from the cafe with a box of leftover food to share
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the box of leftover food. Carries the box out of the cafe to the EV. Opens the driver door. Places the box on the passenger seat. Sits in the driver seat. Fastens the seat belt. Presses the start button. Shifts to drive. Drives out of the parking spot. Drives along the road home. Stops at the driveway. Pulls into the driveway. Presses the park button. Switches off the EV. Unfastens the seat belt. Picks up the box of leftover food. Opens the door. Steps out. Locks the EV with the key fob. Walks to the front door. Unlocks the front door. Pushes it open.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a late leftover-food lunch with Member 1 and labelling the leftover food before storing it in the fridge
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen carrying the box. Puts the box on the kitchen bench. Opens the box lid. Takes out the food containers. Takes two plates from the cupboard. Spoons the leftover food onto the plates. Carries the plates to the kitchen table. Sits down at the table opposite Member 1. Eats the food with a fork. Drinks water from a glass. Talks with Member 1 about his night shift and her morning shift. Stands up. Carries her plate to the sink. Opens the fridge. Takes out containers. Spoons the remaining leftover food into a container. Closes the container lid. Picks up a marker pen. Writes her name and the date on the container label. Presses the label onto the container. Opens the fridge door. Places the container on the fridge shelf. Closes the fridge door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes (Member 1 is studying in Bedroom 1, so the bathroom is free)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the kitchen to the bathroom. Pushes the bathroom door open. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the shower tap. Tests the water temperature with her hand. Pulls off the work shirt and trousers. Unties and removes the apron. Steps into the shower. Washes her body with soap. Washes her hair with shampoo. Rinses off. Turns off the shower tap. Steps out of the shower. Picks up the towel. Dries her hair and body. Pulls on a clean top and trousers. Picks up her work clothes from the floor. Turns off the bathroom light. Pushes the door open. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily prayer and a quiet moment to reset
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Turns on the room light. Rolls out the prayer mat on the floor. Faces the mat direction. Kneels down on the mat. Bows forward with hands on the mat. Sits back on her heels. Recites prayer words aloud in a low voice. Bows again. Sits upright. Turns her head to the right and to the left. Stands up. Rolls up the prayer mat. Places the mat back in the corner. Sits on the bed with her hands in her lap.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on design studio coursework on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Sits down at the desk in Bedroom 2. Pulls the chair in. Turns on the desk lamp. Presses the computer power button. Waits for it to load. Types the password on the keyboard. Opens the design software. Clicks the file menu. Opens the studio project file. Moves the mouse to select a canvas. Types text into the layout. Drags shapes across the artboard with the mouse. Presses the keyboard shortcut to save. Opens a second file with reference images. Zooms in on the image with the mouse wheel. Switches back to the layout file. Types more text. Adjusts the colour panel with the mouse. Presses save again. Exports the file as a PDF. Opens the browser to check the assignment brief. Reads the brief on the screen. Scrolls down the page with the mouse. Closes the browser tab. Types more edits into the design file. Presses save. Leans back and stretches her arms.

enriched_activities.activity: Tea and a snack break, checking the tea shelf stock
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk. Walks out of Bedroom 2 to the kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Fills the kettle with water at the sink. Puts the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a mug and a tea bag. Puts the tea bag into the mug. Pours the boiled water into the mug. Opens the snack cupboard. Takes out a packet of biscuits. Opens the packet. Takes out two biscuits. Eats them. Opens the tea shelf cupboard. Picks up each tea box and counts them. Moves the boxes to the front of the shelf. Closes the cupboard. Picks up the mug and drinks the tea while standing at the bench.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking her own medically safe dinner using her clearly labelled ingredients; also quickly adding her work clothes to Member 1's shared load of laundry in the washing machine so one load washes both
enriched_activities.desc: Opens the fridge door. Takes out her labelled ingredient containers. Puts them on the kitchen bench. Closes the fridge door. Takes a chopping board and knife from the drawer. Places the vegetables on the board. Cuts the vegetables into pieces with the knife. Turns on the induction cooker. Pours oil into the pan. Tips the cut vegetables into the pan. Stirs the food with a spatula. Adds the labelled sauce from the container. Stirs again. Turns down the induction cooker. Picks up her work clothes from the floor of Bedroom 2. Walks to the bathroom. Opens the washing machine lid. Puts her work clothes into the drum on top of Member 1's load. Closes the washing machine lid. Presses the start button. Walks back to the kitchen. Turns off the induction cooker. Spoons the cooked food onto a plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen table together with Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4
enriched_activities.desc: Carries her plate to the kitchen table. Pulls out a chair. Sits down at the table with Member 1, Member 3 and Member 4. Picks up her fork. Eats the food from her plate. Picks up her glass and drinks water. Turns to Member 3 and asks about her clinical placement day. Nods while Member 4 talks about his web development work. Picks up the fork again and finishes the food on the plate. Puts the fork down on the plate. Stands up from the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping the bench, sharing the kitchen tidy-up with Member 1 and Member 4
enriched_activities.desc: Carries her plate and glass to the sink. Turns on the tap. Picks up the sponge. Squeezes dish soap onto the sponge. Scrubs the plate under the running water. Rinses the plate. Places the plate in the drying rack. Washes the glass and places it in the drying rack. Picks up the pan and scrubs it. Rinses the pan. Places the pan in the drying rack. Turns off the tap. Picks up the cloth. Wipes the kitchen bench with the cloth. Wrings the cloth over the sink. Wipes the table surface with the cloth. Hangs the cloth on the hook. Pushes the chairs back under the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing design deadline work on the computer and tidying her desk area
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Sits down at the desk. Turns on the desk lamp. Presses the computer power button. Types the password. Opens the design software. Opens the studio project file. Clicks on the layout page. Types the heading text. Resizes the text box with the mouse. Drags an image into the layout. Aligns the image with the guides. Presses the keyboard shortcut to save. Opens the export menu. Saves the file as a PDF. Closes the software window. Stacks loose papers on the desk into a pile. Puts pens into the pen holder. Straightens the lamp on the desk. Wipes the desk surface with a tissue. Throws the tissue in the bin. Presses the computer shut-down button.

enriched_activities.activity: Short walk to the local shop to buy tea and milk
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk. Picks up her keys, phone and a tote bag. Walks to the front door. Pulls on her shoes. Opens the front door. Steps out. Closes and locks the front door. Walks down the driveway to the street. Walks along the footpath to the local shop. Pushes the shop door open. Walks to the drinks aisle. Picks up a carton of milk. Walks to the tea shelf. Picks up a box of tea. Carries both to the counter. Puts them on the counter. Takes out her phone and pays at the card reader. Puts the milk and tea into the tote bag. Picks up the bag. Walks out of the shop. Walks back along the footpath. Walks up the driveway. Unlocks the front door. Pushes it open. Steps inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening shower and wash-up before bed, timed to finish before Member 1's 21:30 bathroom slot
enriched_activities.desc: Walks from the front door to the bathroom. Pushes the bathroom door open. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the shower tap. Tests the water with her hand. Pulls off her top and trousers. Steps into the shower. Washes her body with soap. Rinses off. Turns off the shower tap. Steps out onto the mat. Picks up the towel. Dries her hair and body. Pulls on her pyjamas. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes her teeth. Rinses her mouth. Spits into the sink. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Hangs the towel on the rail. Turns off the bathroom light. Pushes the door open. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening prayer and quiet reflection
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 2. Turns on the room light. Rolls out the prayer mat on the floor. Kneels down on the mat. Bows forward with hands on the mat. Sits back on her heels. Recites prayer words in a low voice. Bows again. Sits upright. Turns her head to the right and to the left. Stands up. Rolls up the prayer mat. Places the mat back in the corner. Sits down on the edge of the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: reading, checking phone and planning tomorrow's shifts, keeping quiet hours
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up a book from the bedside table. Lies back on the bed. Opens the book. Reads several pages. Closes the book. Puts the book back on the bedside table. Picks up her phone. Unlocks the screen. Opens the shift roster app. Scrolls through tomorrow's shift times. Taps the screen to set an alarm for 05:15. Puts the phone on the bedside table. Stands up. Turns off the room light. Walks to the desk. Turns off the desk lamp. Walks back to the bed. Pulls back the blanket. Lies down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed in Bedroom 2. Pulls the blanket up to her shoulders. Closes her eyes. Lies still on her side. Turns onto her back. Breathes steadily. Does not get out of bed. Keeps the room light off. Remains on the bed.
